scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-levelplay-spm.mjs && node scripts/patch-levelplay-consent.mjs && node scripts/patch-levelplay-android-sdk.mjs
scripts.build:test: npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs test
scripts.build:live: node scripts/check-levelplay-config.mjs ios && VITE_AD_MODE=live npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs live
scripts.build:adsoff: VITE_ADS=off npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs off
scripts.build:mock: VITE_ADS=mock npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs mock
scripts.build:tf: VITE_ADS=off npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs off
scripts.build:tf:mock: VITE_ADS=mock npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs mock
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:adsoff && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios off
scripts.ios:sync:mock: npm run build:mock && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios mock
scripts.ios:sync:test: npm run build:test && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios test
scripts.ios:testflight: npm run build:tf && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios off
scripts.ios:testflight:mock: npm run build:tf:mock && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios mock
scripts.ios:appstore: npm run build:live && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios live

levelplay.userTrackingDescription: Allow tracking so the ads you see stay relevant. The game plays the same either way.
